源自 SNG00575　與 agcho (近似SNG00043的字根); 動詞

欽定本 - hang (one's) self 1; 1

1) 懸樑自盡 (#太27:5|)
record.edic_text:
519 apagchomai {ap-ang'-khom-ahee}

from 575 and agcho (to choke akin to the base of 43);; v

AV - hang (one's) self 1; 1

1) to throttle, strangle, in order to put out of the way or kill
2) to hang one's self, to end one's life by hanging
